tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: exactly one finished opaque landscape 4:3 illustrated architectural poster, a continuation of the user's cheerful Moscow district series, this time temporally styled to 1994–2000.

Input images, in fixed order:
Image 1 is the ARCHITECTURAL EDIT TARGET: a photograph of this exact building. Preserve its recognizable massing, facade rhythm, materials, connected roof forms and oblique viewpoint; transform it into the final illustration.
Image 2 is the USER-APPROVED MOSSOVET SERIES REFERENCE. Use its warm humane mood, luminous architectural illustration, substantial light space, tactile print finish, integrated narrative people, oversized place name and restrained series numbering. The requested 1994–2000 time period OVERRIDES its mid-century Soviet art direction: replace pioneer-era styling with optimistic Moscow neighborhood life and commercial/cultural printed graphics of the late 1990s. Do not copy its building, red columns, pioneers, text or tiny signature.
Image 3 is a NEUTRAL TYPE AND COMPOSITION GUIDE. Its real Cyrillic letterforms, hierarchy and safe caption positions are layout anchors. Its gray field and rough polygon are instructions only, not art. Final actual building must replace the polygon with its true silhouette. Preserve broad hierarchy while integrating people coherently.

Art direction: a beautifully drawn, warmly nostalgic late-1990s Moscow printed district poster. Hand-painted architectural illustration meets confident 1994–2000 desktop-publishing typography. Light warm paper, luminous cyan and cobalt, restrained raspberry-magenta and yellow accents, vivid but well-balanced local colors. Large robust Cyrillic grotesk place title with a fine contrasting inline or outline and a short clean offset shadow typical of printed cultural flyers of the period. Refined small offset-print grain; crisp clean geometry in text, softer observed shading in the building and people. A few restrained diagonal color strips can organize the margins, but no excessive graphic confetti. The poster must feel like the late 1990s, while remaining as welcoming as the approved series. Neither a mid-century propaganda print nor shiny later cyber-Y2K graphics. Architecture is the hero and occupies most of the middle, with a modest narrative group in the foreground. A sunny late spring/early summer afternoon; faces and gestures feel naturally observed.

Temporal constraints: style and narrative reference 1994–2000; the available architecture photograph is later, so this is a poetic stylization, not an exact archival reconstruction. Use ordinary late-1990s Moscow casual clothing and period objects. No pioneer uniforms/neckerchiefs, Soviet work brigades, smartphones, wireless earbuds, QR codes, LED video billboards, modern delivery couriers, electric scooters, post-2000 car silhouettes or present-day retail-chain logos. Remove modern cars, utility wires, modern publicity, security signs, extraneous sign towers and unrelated visual clutter from Image 1. No invented dated historical event, film premiere or opening ceremony.

Typography system: series number small but distinct at upper left, locality across the top, modest period label at upper right. Giant place name in the upper third. Real roof contour may pass in front of a very small lower portion of the title, but leave every character readily readable. Clear lower-left caption and address in dedicated light space; keep feet and props away from those lines. Do not let image-title overlap sacrifice legibility.

Subject: Авангард at 18 General Belov Street, Moscow, near Domodedovskaya metro. Keep the exact pale stone modernist block with very tall narrow projecting structural piers, deep rectangular recessed facade bays, dark horizontal glazing, tall plain upper spandrels, flat parapet, broad shallow entrance steps and the strong original perspective seen from near its corner. Preserve the pale material: do NOT turn these piers into the Mossovet's red columns or invent a cinema marquee. The dark recesses can reflect cool blue; sunlit stone is warm ivory with subtle pink-violet shading. Remove the modern long banner and replace it with a modest architectural inscription reading only АВАНГАРД. Keep the full building composition inside comfortable margins rather than chopping its corner against the top edge. Let the true top corner overlap just a little of the large title's lower strokes.

Narrative: a small group of four anonymous young adults meeting outside the culture center in approximately 1997–1999: easy smiles, conversation and anticipation of a neighborhood cultural evening. One wears a loose light denim jacket over a striped T-shirt and relaxed jeans; one a cream and turquoise color-block windbreaker; a young woman wears a simple patterned midi dress with a denim layer; the fourth wears a casual light shirt and straight jeans. One holds a small portable audio-cassette player with thin wired foam headphones, another a plain paper ticket. These are subtle recognizable everyday objects, not oversized decorative props. Keep all four figures modest relative to the building, together near the right side of the lower foreground, leaving lower-left captions clear. Small fresh green trees frame the building edge; open warm daylight fills the plaza. No dancing stage or live show is invented.

Primary colors for this poster: pale warm stone, soft blue sky, cobalt title with a restrained magenta offset shadow, touches of turquoise and warm yellow. The left structural corner rises dynamically into the text field; preserve the strong architectural drawing and sense of generous air.

Text (verbatim):
05
МОСКВА · ДОМОДЕДОВСКАЯ
1994–2000
АВАНГАРД
Центр культуры и искусства
Улица Генерала Белова, 18

The only optional repeated text is the same small architectural inscription АВАНГАРД on the facade.

Final constraints: Render only the explicitly listed text plus the explicitly permitted building name, spelled exactly in Cyrillic. No extra slogans, meaningless micro-writing, logos, signatures, watermarks, labels, UI widgets, gray guide outlines or rectangular pasted photographs. Ordinary anatomy, plausible scale and one consistent light direction. No additional unseen stories or architectural bays. Deliver one complete richly observed landscape poster.
